_about: What www.tiktok.com answered the watcher on 2026-10-08 for TikTok's US privacy policy: its robots.txt group for all agents (as served) allows /legal, and the page answers 302 to /404. The Wayback Machine has 200 captures of the same address from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07, so this is a refusal, not a move.
